plate.title: B12 · Rotating eight-petal chamber flowers
plate.description: Large eight-petal flowers cover the middle of the stepped-arm field. Four broad long petals carry the dominant turning read; four shorter interleaved petals and a double collar provide a second scale. The native closed arm contours and diagonal disposition are retained underneath the intentionally occluding ornamental reading.

constructionNotes: Large eight-petal flowers cover the middle of the stepped-arm field. Four broad long petals carry the dominant turning read; four shorter interleaved petals and a double collar provide a second scale. The native closed arm contours and diagonal disposition are retained underneath the intentionally occluding ornamental reading. Curved rendering rounds selected flowing contours only; pointed tips, roots and native source seam identities remain fixed. Four colour groups are exact disjoint path selections, not screen-location bins.
